title: Spectral gap for the three-dimensional damped cubic wave equation with degenerate noise
summary: We establish a weighted Wasserstein spectral gap for the three-dimensional damped cubic wave equation with genuinely finite rank Brownian forcing. Under a saturation condition, the gap holds with respect to the negative phase topology $\mathcal E_s=H^{-s}\times H^{-1-s}$ for every $0<s<1/2$, from which we deduce unique ergodicity and exponential mixing in the energy topology. Sharp geometric characterizations of the saturation condition are also obtained. The method we develop is a stable--compact asymptotic coupling mechanism for hypoelliptic dissipative SPDEs beyond the parabolic setting.…
